name: io.github.allooloo/getticker
title: Allooloo Ticker
description: The issuer behind a ticker: ISIN, LEI, listing and status, from the record: signed and receipted.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: get_ticker is the issuer behind a ticker: a ticker and its exchange, or an ISIN or LEI, returns the issuer, its ISIN, its LEI, its listing and its status — every value with its source page and read date, signed by the node of the listing's market and receipted. Served from the record as read; a value the market's record does not carry says not_on_record. Typed errors: unknown_issuer, ambiguous, not_on_record (per field, per market), invalid_request. Door: https://mcp.getticker.ai/mcp (routes to the owning node); every node door answers it for its own market.

exchange.description: Optional exchange for a ticker (NASDAQ, LSE, XETRA, TSX, …).

tools.name: resolve_issuer
tools.description: Find a listed company by ticker, ISIN or LEI. The router names the issuer's home market and forwards to that market's MCP for the record summary.

identifier.description: Ticker with or without exchange (SHOP, TSX:SHOP, SHEL.L, BHP.AX, D05.SI, NESN.SW, SAP.DE, 7203.T, 005930.KS), ISIN, LEI, an exact legal name or a sourced alias.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: Every market on the roster (nodes.json, with its region), which are live, and each market's MCP and agent card.
